status: Fixed contract and literal cases, saved before the new connected draft and any compiler feedback on it.
alphabet: Raw = List (Option Bool); none is the delimiter, some false and some true are data.
parser_contract: For every raw, input and cert: splitLiteral raw = some (input, cert) iff raw = literalPair input cert.
checking_contract: For every raw: verifyDelimited raw = true iff exists input cert, raw = literalPair input cert and (verifyBitsRun input cert).1 = true.
malformed_contract: Missing delimiter or a second delimiter, with any subsequent tail, gives splitLiteral raw = none and verifyDelimited raw = false.
reuse_rule: Consume the existing general proofs directly. Do not reprove the parser or present the requested equivalence as newly missing mathematics.

cases.name: mixed_order
cases.raw: [some true, some false, none, some false, some true]
cases.checking: Exactly (verifyBitsRun [true, false] [false, true]).1; do not guess its value.

cases.name: repeated_with_more_tail
cases.raw: [some false, none, some true, none, some false, none]

boundary: The new connected draft remains UNCOMPILED. Proof-side parser/language facts are reused; this does not add machine execution, a class, NP equivalence, effectivity or acceptance.
